description: This file contains unit tests for the GrainLocatorResolver class in the Orleans distributed systems framework. It tests the resolution of different types of grain locators such as DHT, cached, and client locators by verifying the returned instances match expected services within a test setup.

classes.name: GrainLocatorResolverTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing grain locator resolution logic in Orleans, ensuring correct locators are returned based on configuration.

methods.name: GrainLocatorResolverTests
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test fixture and setting up Orleans host and services.

methods.name: ReturnsDhtGrainLocatorWhenUsingDhtDirectory
methods.description: Tests that the GrainLocatorResolver returns a DhtGrainLocator instance when a DHT directory is used.

methods.name: ReturnsCachedGrainLocatorWhenUsingCustomDirectory
methods.description: Tests that the GrainLocatorResolver returns a CachedGrainLocator instance when a custom directory is used.

methods.name: ReturnsClientGrainLocatorWhenUsingClient
methods.description: Tests that the GrainLocatorResolver returns a ClientGrainLocator instance when resolving for a client.
